observed: On Parts Velocity, pointing at the info icon beside "Units Sold" shows the explanation, starting "Units taken out of inventory stock on invoiced work orders in this date range."
Moving the pointer away hides it.
Pointing at the icon again shows it again.
Clicking the icon while the explanation is open closes it; nothing is showing after the click.
Pressing Tab until the icon has focus shows the explanation.
On Work In Progress, pointing at the first info icon in the summary strip shows its explanation: "The total value of completed work order lines on work orders that are still in progress."
Moving the pointer away hides it.
Pointing at the icon again shows it again.
Clicking the icon while the explanation is open closes it; nothing is showing after the click.
